title: Tsukkomi Machi no Machino-san

titleNative: ツッコミ待ちの町野さん
synopsis: She throws out the jokes, and I can’t help but be the straight man. An after-school rom-com filled with emotion and laughs! “Machino-san from the swim team always drops by the Domino Club's room, where I’m the only member, before her practice starts. She constantly fires off jokes in a sketch-style conversation, and I can’t help but fire back. Back-and-forth banter, teasing words. Conversations full of nonsense... and maybe something more. Every day passed in a flash, yet those summer days felt like they could last forever in that clubroom. But when this summer ends, the dominoes between us will all begin to fall, at once.” “Why did you suddenly start narrating a light-novel-style summary, Machino-san?”

synopsis: Ragna, the heir to a frontier noble family, is a man reborn into the world of a dating simulation game. He wants nothing more than to live an easy, laid-back life, but finds himself worn down managing his land in a harsh frontier environment. Suddenly one day, Ragna receives a proposal to marry a high-ranking noble. However, his new bride, the duke’ s daughter Alicia, is the dating game’s villainess! Contrary to Ragna’s expectations, Alicia turns out to be extremely kind. It seems the reason she is cast as a villain isn't due to her character, but for the expediency of the game's story. Can Ragna ward off the malign influences closing in and save Alicia from her ruinous fate?! (Source: One Peace Books)

title: Konya Coin Laundry de Aimashou
titleRomaji: Konya Coin Laundry de Aimashou
titleNative: 今夜コインランドリーで逢いましょう
synonyms: See you at the laundromat tonight
synopsis: Narita, a family restaurant employee in his late twenties who is always busy with work, is feeling down about the results of his job interview, while he is having dinner, he is absentmindedly watching a video recommended to him on a video site. The video shows Sasa Yoruzaki, an artist with an overwhelming sense of fashion and singing ability, despite her cool and slightly cheeky responses. Later, when he goes to an old laundromat to deal with some laundry problems, he suddenly notices a woman and feels something is off about her. The woman seems familiar, but it is Sasa herself, the one he had just seen in the video.

titleRomaji: Yama, Kaimashita: Isekai Kurashi mo Warukunai
titleNative: 山、買いました 〜異世界暮らしも悪くない〜
synopsis: I'm Satsuki Mochizuki, 27 years old. After being unexpectedly dumped by my boyfriend, whom I thought I would marry, I tried solo camping and surprisingly found it quite enjoyable. In a twist of fate, I end up buying a mountain, only to discover it's an unexpected fantasy world. Now, I aim to escape from tent life and embark on a slow life in this otherworldly existence, prioritizing a tranquil lifestyle over romance. (Source: Kakuyomu, translated)
